    all_msgs.extend(page_msgs)
    if len(page_msgs) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

    print('sender:', m['sender']['name'], m['sender']['phone_number'], 'sent_at:', m['sent_at'], 'message:', m['message'])

unique_numbers=sorted({m['sender']['phone_number'] for m in incoming if m.get('sender',{}).get('phone_number')})
print('unique_sender_numbers:', unique_numbers)

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1608, access_token=simple_login['access_token'])
content = note['content']
print('note title:', note['title'])
print('content snippet:', content.splitlines()[:15])

# Parse movie entries: format in note: Title line, then lines starting with ' - director:' etc.
entries=[]
lines=content.splitlines()
current=None
for line in lines:
    line_str=line.strip()
    if not line_str:
        continue
    # Title lines don't start with '-' or '#'
    if not line_str.startswith('-') and not line_str.startswith('#'):
        # start new entry
        current={'title': line_str}
        entries.append(current)
    elif line_str.startswith('- director:'):
        if current is not None:
            current['director']=line_str.replace('- director:','').strip()
    else:
        # ignore genres etc
        pass

print('parsed entries count:', len(entries))
print('first few:', entries[:5])

fincher_movies=[e['title'] for e in entries if e.get('director','').lower()=='david fincher']
print('fincher_movies:', fincher_movies)

all_movies=[e['title'] for e in entries]
print('all_movies count:', len(all_movies))

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1608, access_token=simple_login['access_token'])
content = note['content']

entries=[]
lines=content.splitlines()
current=None
for line in lines:
    line_str=line.strip()
    if not line_str:
        continue
    if line_str.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if not line_str.startswith('-'):
        current={'title': line_str}
        entries.append(current)
    elif line_str.startswith('- director:'):
        if current is not None:
            current['director']=line_str.replace('- director:','').strip()

movies=[e['title'] for e in entries]
message_text=", ".join(movies)
print('movies:', movies)
print('message_text:', message_text)

# Send reply to Christopher Burch (phone number from recent incoming texts to Joyce)
recipient_phone='4275730168'
resp=apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=recipient_phone, message=message_text, access_token=phone_login['access_token'])
print('send_text_message response:', resp)
